name: Kayano Hinari
source:
The kind and mature eldest daughter of the Kayano family who'd been studying overseas for a few years. Though Hinari appears emotionless on the outside, she is quite emotional and passionate on the inside and when angered, her expression changes completely. When things don't go well, she has a habit of puffing her cheeks up.

[spoiler] It is revealed in the true ending that she is the daughter of Fuuma and Naho. She came to stop Naho and Fuuma relationship so that she doesn't exist. She has a illness that cannot be treated. In order to save her beloved parents who dies from giving parts of their body to her. The treatment and medicine were found later. She blames herself for her parents death [/spoiler]
